name: Hyundai Veloster N MT
notes: 1.0.8: dyno validation (2026-08-02, tuned 2021 VN MT on Dynocom): app peak torque 313 lb-ft vs 312.0 wheel lb-ft measured; power within ~4% (ECU net-torque model). Confirmed manual cars never broadcast 0x080/0x081 (full-bus capture) so the 500 Nm reference fallback is always active. ManifoldPressure description corrected to 0x557 (canId was already right).

signals.name: AccelPedalPos
signals.description: Accelerator pedal position fallback from EMS16 (0x329) D6.

signals.name: LongAccel
signals.description: Longitudinal acceleration from CAN 0x49D D3 + D4[3:0] (12-bit, manual layout).

signals.name: YawRate
signals.description: Yaw rate from ESP12 (0x220) D5 + D6[3:0] (12-bit manual layout).

signals.name: SteeringSpeed
signals.description: Steering wheel rotation speed from SAS11 (0x2B0) D2 (8-bit manual layout).

signals.name: ClutchSwitch
signals.description: Clutch pedal switch from 0x329 D3 bit 7 (1 = pressed).

signals.name: BrakeSwitch
signals.description: Brake pedal switch from 0x329 D4 bit 1 (1 = pressed).

signals.name: WheelSpeed_FL
signals.description: Front left wheel speed (14-bit, manual layout).

signals.name: WheelSpeed_FR
signals.description: Front right wheel speed (14-bit, manual layout).

signals.name: WheelSpeed_RL
signals.description: Rear left wheel speed (14-bit, manual layout).

signals.name: WheelSpeed_RR
signals.description: Rear right wheel speed (14-bit, manual layout).

signals.name: CurrentGear
signals.description: Manual transmission current gear from 0x492 D5. 0x88..0xB0 map to gears 1..6; 0x80 shift/unknown; 0xB8 neutral.

signals.name: NMode_Engine
signals.description: N Mode Engine setting (0=Normal, 1=Sport, 2=Sport+, 3=unset/default).

signals.name: NMode_Suspension
signals.description: N Mode Suspension setting (0=Comfort, 1=Normal, 2=Sport, 3=unset/default).

signals.name: NMode_ESC
signals.description: N Mode ESC setting (0=On, 1=Sport, 2=Off, 3=unset/default).

signals.name: NMode_Exhaust
signals.description: N Mode Exhaust setting (0=Quiet, 1=Normal, 2=Sport+, 3=unset/default).

signals.name: NMode_RevMatch
signals.description: N Mode Rev-match enabled (0=Off, 1=On).

signals.name: NMode_eLSD
signals.description: N Mode e-LSD setting (0=Normal, 1=Sport, 2=Sport+, 3=unset/default).

signals.name: NMode_Steering
signals.description: N Mode Steering setting (0=Comfort, 1=Normal, 2=Sport, 3=unset/default).

signals.name: ManifoldPressure
signals.description: Manifold absolute pressure from MAP (0x557) D4, kPa absolute. Validated on the 2026-08-02 MT WOT capture: 28 kPa overrun vacuum to 245 kPa (~21 psi boost) at WOT, r=0.995 against TQI. (Description previously misprinted the ID as 0x547; canId 1367 = 0x557 was always correct.)

signals.name: BatteryCurrent
signals.description: Battery current. Unsigned 16-bit LE centered at raw 32768 = 0A. Negative = charging.

signals.name: IntakeTemp
signals.description: Intake air temperature fallback from INTAKE_TEMP_2 (0x547) D2.
